messages:
marta: Quick a11y pass from today's smoke test (NVDA+Firefox + VoiceOver spot checks). Keeping it tight so we can triage in planning.

zhou: drop the highlights pls 🙏

marta: screens checked: Models page (tabs + breadcrumbs), topbar search, results table, and details panel. Top items:
• Skip link is present but invisible on first Tab (not in tab order until you press Tab twice) — probably hidden via JS focus handling.
• Tablist for Models/All/Trained is implemented visually but missing role="tablist"/role="tab" and aria-selected; VoiceOver treats them as plain buttons and they aren't announced as tabs.
• Breadcrumbs use anchors but no aria-current on the active crumb; NVDA doesn't announce current page.
• Search input has placeholder but no label element or aria-label; SR reads generic "search" sometimes, inconsistent.
• Results table: sortable column headers have aria-sort toggled but header text not included in the announcement for some screen readers (announce reads "sorted ascending" only). Need full accessible name like "Model name, sorted ascending".
• Details panel: when opened, focus moves into panel but on close focus sometimes lands after the panel in DOM (skip to next focusable) — needs restoreFocus to originating trigger.
• Small tag chips (status pills) in dark theme are low contrast against bg at 12px (around 3.1:1).
• Decorative sparkline SVGs inside metric cards are being announced as "graphic" — should be aria-hidden="true" or have role="img" + aria-hidden true if decorative.

keisha: environment? which reader did you repro on?

marta: NVDA on Windows for the table header issues, VoiceOver on macOS for tablist/breadcrumbs, and axe flagged missing labels + contrast.

product_ali: prioritization?

zhou: my take: tablist semantics + search label + focus restore P0. table header announce + skip link behavior P1. contrast + svg aria P2.

dev-ryan: I'll take the tablist and focus restore. Plan: add role="tablist" on container and role="tab" on each tab button, toggle aria-selected and tabindex for keyboard roving. Also ensure keyboard handlers use Left/Right to move focus per WAI-ARIA authoring practices. For the details panel, I'll call `trigger.focus()` on close and add an e2e keyboard test.

keisha: for the search input I'll add a visually-hidden <label> and also aria-label fallback for the component API so both code paths covered. Example: `<label class=\"sr-only\" for=\"top-search\">Search models</label><input id=\"top-search\" />`.

marta: table header announcement: suggest we compute accessible name combining header text + sort direction via `aria-label={`${title} column, sorted ${direction}`}` on the <th> toggle button. That should make SRs announce full context.

dev-ryan: good call. I'll implement aria-label on the header buttons and add a tiny unit test checking the attribute.

keisha: contrast suggestion: either slightly darken the pill fill token or add a 1px high-contrast stroke for micro text. I'll propose a token change and push to Figma.

marta: snippet for skip link: ensure it is first focusable element and visible on focus:
```css
.skip-link:focus { position: static; clip: auto; }
```
and ensure no keyboard handler prevents initial focus.

product_ali: copy tweak: change breadcrumb last item tooltip from "Current" to include context: "Current page: Models" so SRs have clear phrasing.

a11y-bot: Automated scan results: 9 issues found. Severity: 3 high (tab semantics, missing search label, focus restore), 4 medium (table header naming, skip link visibility, decorative SVGs, aria-current), 2 low (contrast refinements, tooltip copy). Full report: /internal/a11y/reports/2570012345

zhou: timeline? can devs split across two PRs: semantic fixes (tablist, labels, header aria) and visual tokens (contrast, focus halo)?

dev-ryan: yes. I'll open PR#1 for tablist + focus restore + header aria by EOD. keisha will do PR#2 for labels + skiplink fix. Token changes can go in a small design token PR with screenshots.

keisha: I'll add sr-only label component and update storybook example. Also adding an integration test that asserts `document.querySelector('#top-search').getAttribute('aria-label')` exists.

marta: thanks team. Checklist for PRs:
- [ ] add role/tablist semantics + keyboard roving + unit tests
- [ ] ensure details panel close restores focus to trigger + e2e keyboard test
- [ ] add visually-hidden label for search + aria-label fallback and storybook sample
- [ ] add aria-label to sortable headers combining title + direction
- [ ] fix skip-link visibility on initial focus
- [ ] mark decorative svgs aria-hidden="true"
- [ ] propose pill token or 1px stroke in design tokens

product_ali: slot semantic fixes into next sprint P0. visual token work P1. Once PRs merge, let's re-run accessibility smoke and post verifications here.

marta: i'll re-test with NVDA/VoiceOver after merges and post a one-liner. thanks all :sparkles:
